patch.title: Minnesota Renaissance Festival 2026: August 22–October 4 Weekends
patch.description: The 2026 Shakopee festival ran weekends August 22–October 4, plus Labor Day and October 2, with jousting, themed weekends and an artisan marketplace.
patch.dateConfidenceReasoning: Confirmed: Discover Shakopee states “weekends August 22-October 4, 2026 (plus Labor Day and Friday, October 2)”; Bloomington tourism corroborates the same dates. This corrects the stored 2026 event, not the distinct August21–October3,2027 edition now on the operator homepage. End is exclusive.
patch.longFormSummary:
• The 2026 festival occupied weekends from August 22 through October 4, with extra openings on Labor Day and Friday October 2. This pin records that historical season; its old August-to-October placeholder and reasoning about an unannounced 2027 season described different years.
  • The programme moved from Once Upon a Time on August 22–23 through Highland Fling, Woofstock, Bold North Adventure, Wine, Chocolate & Romance and Art Affair to Oktoberfest on October 3–4. Shakopee tourism describes more than 250 artisans alongside stage entertainment and jousting.
  • The operator’s retained opening-weekend page confirms August 22–23 and explicitly labels its admission offers 2026. Its fairy-house competition and children’s activities belong to that weekend rather than the whole season.
  • Bloomington’s tourism calendar independently retains the August 22–October 4,2026 span and identifies Shakopee as the venue area. The current operator homepage and season-pass checkout have advanced to 2027, so their newer prices must not be read as 2026 ticket inventory.

addReferences.reasoning: Explicit historical2026 dates and extra days.

note: Recovered historical2026 festival dates from edition-specific tourism and operator sources; removed mixed-year date reasoning.

patch.title: San Antonio Missions 2027 Home Games: April 2–September 5
patch.description: Missions home games run April 2–September 5,2027. Times remain TBA.
patch.dateConfidenceReasoning: Scheduled: the official2027 printable calendar marks blue as HOME. April2–4 versus AMA and August31–September5 versus NWA are blue; September7–12 at CC are ROAD. Final home date September5; exclusive end September6. Dates subject to change.
patch.longFormSummary:
• The team’s printable2027 schedule labels April2–4 against Amarillo as home games. The final blue home block is August31–September5 against Northwest Arkansas.
  • The legend distinguishes blue HOME, cream ROAD and grey OFF cells. September7–12 at Corpus Christi are road fixtures; September12 therefore cannot be the home-season end. This span covers intermittent home series, not games every day.
  • Game times remain unpublished in the announcement; the calendar warns that dates are subject to change.
